track_item.speedpost_flags.extraction: kind8 item+0x28 uint16; low3bits select subtype. In004f5862 mask100 selects mph scaling; otherwise native approximate km/h scaling. For nonzero subtype,mask80 admits either class,mask40 freight,mask20 default non-freight.
track_item.speedpost_flags.evidence_status: Serializer and installed-asset payloads traced;004f5862 subtype/unit/applicability gates and service class producers traced; crossing transitions remain unvalidated
track_item.speedpost_flags.limitations: Default non-freight class does not prove passenger carriage or occupancy. Service class has both initialization and physical-consist update producers; coupling reclassification cadence remains unvalidated. Subtypes4/5 set/clear a route-cap gate; zone names are not established.

track_item.speedpost_float_value.extraction: kind8 item+0x2c float32; serializer includes it when low3bits==0 OR mask10 is set. Inspected speed-limit consumer004f5862 does not read this payload.
track_item.speedpost_float_value.evidence_status: Conditional serializer and installed asset values traced; no speed-limit use of this float in inspected004f5862; physical meaning/unit still subtype-dependent and unresolved
track_item.speedpost_float_value.limitations: Do not interpret every float payload as speed. Numeric correspondence to a distance marker is insufficient to establish exact marker units or display behavior. Byte+2a is the converted restriction input in the inspected consumer; absence there is not proof of no other float consumers.
